guidance.statement: The company expects to spend another INR 1,000 crore to INR 1,500 crore in capex this year.
guidance.quote: Further this year, we'll spend around another INR 1,000 crore to INR 1,500 crore this year further.

guidance.statement: Total capital spend on ongoing projects is targeted around INR 3,200 crore this year.
guidance.quote: So total spend will be around in the range of INR 3,200 crore.

guidance.statement: Polycarbonate asset commissioning is targeted for H2 FY28-29.
guidance.quote: I would anticipate that we would target H2 for our polycarbonate commissioning.

guidance.statement: Bisphenol A (BPA) plant commissioning is targeted a couple of months after polycarbonate.
guidance.quote: And we would target BPA, which would be commissioned maybe a couple of months after that.

guidance.statement: An investment of INR 70-odd crore is planned for further debottlenecking phenol assets to touch 4 lakh tonnes.
guidance.quote: I'll just mention that we are going to make, I think, about some INR 70-odd crore investment further in debottlenecking the assets to be able to touch about 4 lakh tonnes.

guidance.statement: MIBK and MIBC will be commissioned along with acetophenone in August itself.
guidance.quote: MIBK as well as MIBC will be commissioned along with acetophenone in August itself, and the rest of them will be commissioned within Q2.

delivered.statement: Consolidated Revenue from Operations stood at INR 2,592 crore, up 35% YoY and 22% sequentially.
EBITDA reached an all-time high of INR 554 crore, growing 159% YoY and 45% sequentially.
EBITDA margins expanded to 21% compared with 11% last year and 18% sequentially.
Profit Before Tax increased to INR 468 crore, up 202% YoY and 55% quarter-on-quarter.
PAT reached INR 345 crore, registering a 207% YoY and 57% sequential growth.
Phenolics revenues increased to INR 1,775 crore, with record EBIT of INR 418 crore.

calls.tone: Confident on demand recovery, integration benefits, record operating performance, and scalable future growth.

pushback.gist: Analysts questioned whether record high phenolics profitability and spreads are sustainable in subsequent quarters.
Scepticism regarding why years of sustained R&D investments have not translated into structurally higher gross margins.
Questions on how feedstock supply is covered to support high levels of phenol production run rates.
Queries on the exact peak debt levels and funding arrangements for the mega polycarbonate project.

business.summary: Deepak Nitrite operates a diversified chemical manufacturing platform spanning Advanced Intermediates, Phenolics, and specialty chemical applications, serving domestic and international customers through integrated value chains and multi-location facilities.

segments.name: Phenolics
segments.note: Highest ever quarterly performance with revenue of INR 1,775 crore.

segments.name: Advanced Intermediates
segments.note: Revenue rose to INR 804 crore, supported by growing integration.

guidance.statement: Multipurpose agrochemical intermediates and MIBK, MIBC projects are scheduled for commissioning in Q2 FY27.
guidance.quote: Our long-term growth remains anchored in value chain integration and specialty chemical expansion. We witnessed a steady progress of our multipurpose agrochemical intermediates and MIBK, MIBC projects, which are scheduled for commissioning in Q2 FY27.

guidance.statement: Polycarbonate project commissioning is expected by June 2028.
guidance.quote: So we've clarified earlier, and we are, by and large, remaining kind of in line with that, and we are expecting it to be commissioned by June 2028.

guidance.statement: Commercial production of new downstream products is expected from Q3 onwards in FY27.
guidance.quote: Therefore, in FY27, we expect a stronger margin profile, even for the standalone business, compared with FY26. We are also working towards a return to what we consider normalcy a couple of years ago. So FY27 will be this period where you will see an improving trend.

guidance.statement: Management anticipates an improvement in margins and gross numbers progressing into FY27.
guidance.quote: Like I said whether it is because of the anti-involution stand or critical hazardous chemistries, etc., or the global demand improvement, whatever you want to call it, we do anticipate an improvement in the margins as well as the gross numbers as we progress into FY27.

delivered.statement: Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue stood at INR2,127 crore.
Q4 FY26 EBITDA stood at INR383 crore with EBITDA margins improving to 18%.
Q4 FY26 profit after tax stood at INR220 crore.
FY26 consolidated revenue stood at INR7,947 crore, with EBITDA of INR1,041 crore and PAT of INR551 crore.
Nitric acid plant operated at approximately 45% utilization during Q4 due to technical issues.

calls.tone: Cautiously optimistic, confident in domestic demand resilience and margin recovery despite global supply chain volatility.

pushback.gist: Analysts pressed on plant utilization rates and whether earlier target EBITDA additions remain achievable.
Questions raised regarding raw material propylene availability, regional price divergence between China and India, and demand patterns.
An analyst inquired about the specific reasons behind the increase in receivable days.
Clarification sought on the funding sources for the large capital expenditure of the polycarbonate project.

guidance.statement: The MIBK/MIBC project is targeted for commissioning within this quarter.
guidance.quote: The MIBK/ MIBC project is progressing well and is targeted for commissioning within this quarter.

guidance.statement: The Group expects a favourable performance and margin recovery in Q4 FY26.
guidance.quote: With this positive backdrop, the Group expects a favourable performance in Q4 FY26.

delivered.statement: Consolidated total revenue stood at INR 1,983 crore in Q3 FY26, growing 3% year-on-year.
EBITDA for Q3 FY26 increased by 16% year-on-year to INR 219 crore.
Phenolics revenue from operations stood at INR 1,334 crore and Advanced Intermediates at INR 652 crore.
Phenolics EBIT reached INR 145 crore, representing a 20% year-on-year increase.

calls.tone: cautious on near-term pricing pressures and margins, but confident on demand recovery and integration benefits.

pushback.gist: Analysts questioned why material margins were low despite strong volume growth, probing the impact of spot raw material purchases.
Analysts pressed management on the timeline and delays in commissioning the MIBK/MIBC and advanced intermediate projects.
Analysts asked why Deepak's outlook is more optimistic than cautious global agrochemical majors.

guidance.statement: Total capital outlay for the next 3 years will be around INR 3,000 crore to INR 4,000 crore.
guidance.quote: It will be around INR 3,000 crore to INR 4,000 crore. Because the total outlay is around INR 9,000 crore. So, INR 3,000 crore, INR 3,500 crore this year and then INR 4,000 crore next year.

guidance.statement: CAPEX guidance for this year is about INR 1,500 crore.
guidance.quote: CAPEX guidance for this year was about INR 1,500 crore. Are you holding on to that? Sanjay Upadhyay: More or less same.

guidance.statement: We anticipate an improvement in performance for AI segment on the back of better volumes for agrochemical-linked intermediates.
guidance.quote: we anticipate an improvement in performance on the back of better volumes for agrochemical-linked intermediates from Europe as well as other geographies

guidance.statement: Upstream integration assets are expected to be fully operational in Q4 FY26.
guidance.quote: upstream integration assets, which are expected to be fully operational in Q4 FY26.

guidance.statement: Polycarbonate project commissioning will be in the month of January to March 2028 quarter.
guidance.quote: it will be in the month of January to March 2028 quarter.

guidance.statement: We are cautiously optimistic about H2, which is better than what we saw in Q2.
guidance.quote: all I can say is that we are cautiously optimistic about H2, which is, I would say, better than what we saw in Q2.

delivered.statement: Q2 FY26 consolidated revenues stood at INR 1,922 crore, higher on a quarter-on-quarter basis.
Reported a 5% quarter-on-quarter increase in consolidated EBITDA at INR 224 crore.
Phenolics business reported revenue growth of 2% sequentially to INR 1,333 crore.
Phenolics EBIT grew 23% sequentially to INR 1,45 crore.
Advanced Intermediates revenue stood at INR 588 crore in Q2 FY26 with EBIT of INR 23 crore.
Commenced hydrogenation asset at Deepak Chem Tech with INR 118 crore investment on 26th September 2025.

calls.tone: cautiously optimistic on demand recovery in H2, navigating headwinds from tariffs and Chinese dumping

pushback.gist: Analysts asked about volume erosion and drop to zero for certain agrochemical intermediates compared to peak levels.
Scepticism regarding depressed phenol spreads, Chinese dumping, and impact of sanctions on raw material flows.
Pressing management on breakup of INR 2,000 crore capital work-in-progress and timelines for polycarbonate project.

guidance.statement: Deepak has outlined a cumulative investment pipeline of approximately Rs 11,500 Crores across multiple platforms.
guidance.quote: Deepak has outlined a cumulative investment pipeline of approximately ₹ 11,500 Crores

guidance.statement: The Polycarbonate manufacturing plant at Dahej will involve an approximate capital expenditure of Rs 11,500 Crores including infrastructure capex.
guidance.quote: putting up an integrated Cumene to Polycarbonate resin plant at Dahej, Gujarat, which will be India’s first PC manufacturing plant at an approximate capital expenditure of ₹ 11,500 Crores.

guidance.statement: Additional investment of about Rs 3,500 Crores is planned for manufacturing Phenol, Acetone and IPA to support PC operations.
guidance.quote: manufacture Phenol, Acetone and IPA with an additional investment of about ₹ 3,500 Crores.

guidance.statement: The polycarbonate resin facility is expected to be commissioned by 2029.
guidance.quote: This facility is expected to be commissioned by 2029.

guidance.statement: MIBK, MIBC and Speciality Chemical plants are scheduled for commissioning in Q2 of FY 2026-27.
guidance.quote: which are scheduled for commissioning in Q2 of FY 2026-27.

delivered.statement: Consolidated Total Income for the year stood at Rs 7,947 Crores, down 5% compared to previous year.
Consolidated EBITDA for the year amounted to Rs 1,041 Crores, down 11% from Rs 1,176 Crores.
Consolidated Profit After Tax (PAT) reached Rs 551 Crores for FY 2025-26.
Standalone Total Revenue, including Other Income, stood at Rs 2,760 Crores for FY 2025-26.
Standalone Profit After Tax (PAT) reached Rs 189 Crores for FY 2025-26.
Deepak Phenolics Limited recorded Revenue of Rs 5,411 Crores with a PAT of Rs 540 Crores.

calls.tone: Cautiously optimistic, highlighting resilience amid external headwinds, pricing pressures, and disciplined execution of strategic growth projects.
